title: Office fit-out
goal: Show a realistic office fit-out network with finish-to-start lag, milestones, and a critical completion chain.

rubric.must: The visible chain runs from strip-out through partitions, rough-in, finishes, furniture, practical completion, and move-in.
Practical completion visibly waits for furniture installation, IT commissioning, and safety inspection.
The dependency from strip-out to partitions visibly carries a one-day finish-to-start lag.
Furniture installation visibly depends on both long-lead furniture ordering and finishes.
Lease handover and practical completion are visibly distinguished as milestones.
A critical path is visually highlighted through the schedule network.
